New in this build:
- Platinum is the master faceplate; Modern, Vintage and Texture are built around it with clean edges.
- New artist-style kits and presets: Toronto Nights, Late Night RnB, ATL Wave, Rockstar Bounce, Vamp Rage, Carolina Soul, LA Lyricist, Soft Soul and Houston Queen.
- Genre kits have their own section in every kit menu.
- Four dice, four jobs: faceplate dice = new sounds, velocity dice = new velocities, channel dice = new channel pattern, top drum roll dice = new sounds and pattern.
- Snap to Scale button in the drum roll channel bar (key, scale, fit notes).

Please try switching faceplates, loading kits and presets, using each dice, and recording MIDI into your DAW. Send feedback with a screenshot if anything looks or sounds off.
